name: app-glass-catalog-pill-nav-over-magenta-and-blue-ribbed-light
title: Glass Catalog Pill Nav over Ribbed Light
whatItIs: A tab pill floating over a background of vertical ribbed glass glowing magenta on the left and periwinkle blue on the right, with a white active segment 'Catalog' with a dot-grid icon and two translucent dark segments holding a library icon and a profile icon.
whatItMeans: The frosted dark pill takes on the colours behind it, and a single opaque white segment makes the active tab unmistakable.
techniques: Translucent pill that picks up backdrop colour
Opaque white active segment with a label
Ribbed glass gradient as a backdrop
Centred component on a full-bleed image
bestFor: Bottom bar and tab pill designs

vocabulary.definition: A fluted glass texture that streaks light into vertical lines.
The opaque part of a tab pill showing the selected item.
A blur applied to what lies behind a translucent element.
